items.text: Business analytics and supply chain management both use data to improve how a business runs, but analytics focuses on finding patterns and guiding decisions across functions, while supply chain focuses on moving goods and managing suppliers, inventory and delivery, so the better choice depends on whether you prefer analysis or physical operations.
Test both with a small project: analyse a sales dataset for one, map a product flow and find a bottleneck for the other.
Read duties in notices before deciding.
